options.content:
### Known blind spots
- Checkpoint freshness by expected schedule/RPO is not instrumented yet.
- Replay duplicate/overwrite risk signal is not instrumented yet.
- Manifest-to-ledger referential integrity ratio is not instrumented yet.

panels.title: Inspect: Known Blind Spots
panels.description: Compact replay-safety blind-spot summary for the selected pipeline/run_type/time range. This is a limitation note, not a healthy signal: the dashboard cannot prove these invariants from current Prometheus metrics. The later Replay-Safety Signal Gaps note is the detailed companion; keep both collapsed until physical merge/removal is scheduled.

Selected-range replay/resume blocker count across manifest writes, ledger appends, checkpoint compatibility, replay reconstructability, replay drift, and lineage refs. Status mapping: 0=OK when Inspect: Telemetry Missing = 0; if telemetry is non-zero or UNKNOWN, validate control-plane metric scrape/rules before trusting zero blockers. 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. Next action: stop replay/resume and investigate the first failing signal; if null, validate control-plane metric scrape/rules first. Empty selected-range series must collapse to 0, not UNKNOWN.

targets.expr:
round((
  (sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
+
  (sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", status="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
+
  (sum(increase(bioetl_checkpoint_compatibility_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", disposition=~".*_incompatible"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
+
  (sum(increase(bioetl_replay_reconstructability_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", status="not_reconstructable"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
+
  (sum(increase(bioetl_replay_drift_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
+
  (sum(increase(bioetl_lineage_refs_missing_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
))

options.content:
### Remaining replay-safety signals

The ID evidence endpoint now exposes manifest/run identity, execution/config/contract/input anchors, replay parentage, copy-friendly full values, and checkpoint anchor compare without adding high-cardinality Prometheus labels.

Signals still intentionally outside this dashboard section:

- checkpoint_age <= recovery window / RPO metric
- replay duplicate-record evidence metric
- occurrence-only vs semantic drift classification beyond bounded replay_drift labels

Do not add PromQL panels for high-cardinality IDs. Use `/ops/control-plane/identity-evidence`, manifest inspection, ledger inspection, checkpoint diagnostics, and artifact/lineage drilldowns for full identity values.
